`sprig` is the shell for tenant users and operators: a full-screen TUI and a scriptable CLI over the REST API or the native protocols.

## `sprig`

```text
SprigDB's shell: a full-screen TUI and a scriptable CLI

Usage: sprig [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  login      Sign in and keep the session (or store an API key or token)
  logout     End the session and forget the profile's secrets
  whoami     Who the gateway thinks you are
  profile    Connection profiles
  stream     Event streams
  queue      Queues
  top        Live dashboards; --once prints one poll
  approvals  The approvals inbox
  admin      Every sprigctl command: sprig admin <sprigctl arguments>
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -p, --profile <profile>    Connection profile
      --url <url>            Gateway URL (overrides the profile)
  -u, --user <user>          Login name
  -d, --database <database>  Database (USE)
      --tenant <tenant>      Tenant to act in (USE TENANT)
  -e, --execute <execute>    Statements to run, then exit
  -f, --file <file>          A script to run (- for stdin)
  -l, --lang <lang>          Language of -e, -f and stdin [default: sql, or the protocol's] [possible values: sql, mongo, redis, cypher]
      --protocol <protocol>  Transport: the gateway's REST API, or a native protocol [default: http] [possible values: http, mysql, mongo, redis, bolt]
  -o, --format <format>      Output [default: table on a terminal, else tsv] [possible values: table, json, ndjson, csv, tsv]
  -y, --yes                  Run destructive statements without asking
      --fail-fast            Stop at the first error
      --max-rows <max-rows>  Row cap per result (0: none)
      --timeout <timeout>    Statement timeout, such as 30s or 500ms
      --plain                A line prompt instead of the TUI
      --admin                Open the TUI on the Admin tab
  -h, --help                 Print help
  -V, --version              Print version
```

### `sprig admin`

```text
SprigDB operator CLI

Usage: sprigctl [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  dc               Data centers
  cluster          MariaDB clusters
  tenant           Tenants
  settings         See and change settings at every scope [alias: config]
  index            Automatic indexes and recommendations
  recommendations  Recommendations held for approval, and their policies
  explain          Explain a query fingerprint, a decision or a tenant's placement
  shard            Shards
  job              Mover jobs
  advisor          The sharding advisor
  gateway          Gateways of the DC
  check            Operational checks
  logic            Logic functions
  space            Spaces and shares
  inherit          Inherited tables, shares, tree-wide ids and the references that refuse deletes
  txn              In-doubt distributed transactions
  sink             Sinks: list, show, pause, resume, reset, dead letters, connections
  graph            Graphs
  search           Search indexes and their copies on workers
  login            Log in as a named operator; the session is kept per endpoint
  logout           End this endpoint's login session
  whoami           Who the Admin API takes you for
  operator         Named platform and DC operators
  token            Tokens you issue for scripts and services
  feed             Change feeds
  import           Copy data and index definitions from a live source
  help             Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --endpoint <endpoint>        Admin API endpoint [default: http://127.0.0.1:7480] [env: SPRIGCTL_ENDPOINT=]
      --token-file <token-file>    A file holding the Admin API bearer token [env: SPRIGCTL_TOKEN_FILE=]
      --ca-file <ca-file>          For an https:// endpoint: the CA (PEM) its certificate is checked against [env: SPRIGCTL_CA_FILE=]
      --client-cert <client-cert>  For an https:// endpoint that requires one: a client certificate (PEM) [env: SPRIGCTL_CLIENT_CERT=]
      --client-key <client-key>    The private key (PEM) of --client-cert [env: SPRIGCTL_CLIENT_KEY=]
      --dc <dc>                    Data center to act in
  -o, --output <output>            Output format [default: table] [possible values: table, json, yaml]
      --dry-run                    Show what would change
      --yes                        Don't ask for confirmation
  -h, --help                       Print help
  -V, --version                    Print version
```
